verdict.rationale: RX 9070 XT is a consumer RDNA GPU positioned for local workstation use; evidence explicitly frames it as an alternative to cloud/datacenter solutions with up to 48GB VRAM on a single workstation, with no mention of NVLink/Infinity Fabric interconnect, multi-GPU scaling, or rack-scale deployment for this SKU (those are reserved for AMD Instinct/CDNA parts).
